records.title: Development of Coastal Districts & small ports in Tamil Nadu
details: a to c: Government of Tamil Nadu has submitted proposal for development of maritime infrastructure worth Rs. 18000 crore for inclusion in Sagarmala 2.0 scheme which is under formulation.

records.title: Capacity of battery based energy storage system.
details: d: CEA has issued draft Central Electricity Authority (Measures relating of Safety and Electric Supply) (First Amendment) Regulations, 2025 on 19.06.2025 for stakeholders' comments, which covers safety requirements for BESS.

records.title: Medical Facilities at AIIMS
details: The establishment of the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Madurai has been sanctioned and cleared by the Cabinet. We are very much concerned about it. Due to some technical reasons, it has been delayed, and we accept that there has been a delay. But the Government is committed and the work has started, and very soon, you will see that the construction work will take place.
